findings.title: Prescriptive guidance undone relative to code
findings.description: The prose added to U2c prescribes that "`need_root` run once in the parent shell or test the abort" and to "add a test that fails when check_line's `import_reset` is removed," but neither `need_root` exists in the codebase nor is such a test present in the code changes. The prose describes implementation work as a completed unit without evidence it was executed.
